items.headline: Post warns that infostealers may expose company AI accounts
items.claim: The post alleges that infostealer malware can collect browser passwords when it reaches a device through a cracked file or fake update.
items.context: As general background, infostealers are malware designed to gather sensitive information from infected devices. Reused or browser-stored credentials can create risks for business accounts, including AI tools.
advice: Block cracked software and untrusted updates.
Require multifactor authentication for business accounts.

items.headline: Actor claims Conexus Mobile Alliance database was allegedly leaked via SQL injection

items.context: As general background, SQL injection can expose data when applications do not safely handle database queries. Forum leak claims may be unverified and do not independently establish access or data authenticity.
advice: Review application logs for suspicious database queries.
Use parameterized queries and test input validation.
